import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/results/10_feb_quenching/gpt_4o/react/quenching/subtask/level_1/brief/na2sio3_quenching_1_subtask_tg_calculation_trial_0/quench_data.csv')

# Filter data to only include temperatures below 2600 K
data = data[data['Temp'] <= 2600]

# Define linear function for fitting
def linear(x, a, b):
    return a * x + b

# Fit the high-temperature (supercooled liquid) region
high_temp_data = data[data['Temp'] > 1500]
popt_high, _ = curve_fit(linear, high_temp_data['Temp'], high_temp_data['Density'])

# Fit the low-temperature (glassy) region
low_temp_data = data[data['Temp'] <= 1500]
popt_low, _ = curve_fit(linear, low_temp_data['Temp'], low_temp_data['Density'])

# Calculate the intersection point
Tg = (popt_low[1] - popt_high[1]) / (popt_high[0] - popt_low[0])

# Plot the data and the fits
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.scatter(data['Temp'], data['Density'], label='Data', s=10)
plt.plot(data['Temp'], linear(data['Temp'], *popt_high), label='High Temp Fit', color='red')
plt.plot(data['Temp'], linear(data['Temp'], *popt_low), label='Low Temp Fit', color='blue')
plt.axvline(Tg, color='green', linestyle='--', label=f'Tg = {Tg:.2f} K')
plt.xlabel('Temperature (K)')
plt.ylabel('Density (g/cm^3)')
plt.title('Density-Temperature Curve')
plt.legend()
plt.savefig('/results/10_feb_quenching/gpt_4o/react/quenching/subtask/level_1/brief/na2sio3_quenching_1_subtask_tg_calculation_trial_0/density_temperature_plot.png')
plt.show()

# Print the glass transition temperature
print(f'{Tg:.2f}')

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/results/10_feb_quenching/gpt_4o/react/quenching/subtask/level_1/brief/na2sio3_quenching_1_subtask_tg_calculation_trial_1/quenching_data.csv')

# Filter data to exclude temperatures above 2600 K
data = data[data['Temp'] <= 2600]

# Define linear function for fitting
def linear(x, a, b):
    return a * x + b

# Fit two linear regimes
# High-temperature regime (supercooled liquid)
high_temp_data = data[data['Temp'] > 1000]  # Adjust threshold as needed
params_high, _ = curve_fit(linear, high_temp_data['Temp'], high_temp_data['Density'])

# Low-temperature regime (glassy)
low_temp_data = data[data['Temp'] <= 1000]  # Adjust threshold as needed
params_low, _ = curve_fit(linear, low_temp_data['Temp'], low_temp_data['Density'])

# Calculate intersection point (Tg)
def find_intersection(p1, p2):
    a1, b1 = p1
    a2, b2 = p2
    return (b2 - b1) / (a1 - a2)

Tg = find_intersection(params_high, params_low)

# Plot the data and fits
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.scatter(data['Temp'], data['Density'], label='Data', color='black')
plt.plot(data['Temp'], linear(data['Temp'], *params_high), label='High Temp Fit', color='red')
plt.plot(data['Temp'], linear(data['Temp'], *params_low), label='Low Temp Fit', color='blue')
plt.axvline(Tg, color='green', linestyle='--', label=f'Tg = {Tg:.2f} K')
plt.xlabel('Temperature (K)')
plt.ylabel('Density (g/cm^3)')
plt.legend()
plt.title('Density-Temperature Curve and Tg Estimation')
plt.savefig('/results/10_feb_quenching/gpt_4o/react/quenching/subtask/level_1/brief/na2sio3_quenching_1_subtask_tg_calculation_trial_1/density_temp_curve.png')
plt.close()

# Print Tg
print(f'{Tg:.2f}')
